Meghalaya Honeymoon Murder Case: Bail for Accused Sparks Legal Battle

The Meghalaya High Court upheld a trial court's decision to grant bail to Sonam Raghuvanshi, the accused in the Raja Raghuvanshi murder case. The court cited police procedural lapses in communicating the grounds of arrest. The victim's family and the Meghalaya government plan to challenge this bail by appealing to the Supreme Court.
